name: Acer Sense Pro
author: Dhruv1249
description: Expanded control center for Acer Nitro/Predator laptops (based on raphamzn/dms-acer-sense): power profiles, custom fans, 4-zone RGB, battery limiter, calibration, LCD overdrive, and GPU mode switching. Installs an optional root helper with a sudoers rule for hardware control.
